reviews.text: Honesty, integrity, transparency, quality workmanship, and friendly open communication are what you can expect from Rusty & Patriot Roofing. Having consulted several roofing companies, Patriot was head & shoulders above the rest. They went above & beyond in handling my insurance claim. Not only was my roof replaced, but several additional items were fixed and upgraded. Rusty always did the right thing and approach every situation with a "do what's right" approach as if it were his own home. They

Patriot was highly recommended by my counterparts where I work in the IT/Business Consulting world where they installed roofs for 3 other houses also heavily damaged in recent hail/wind storms in the Flower Mound area. In our business our success is based on delivery and how we finish. Eric, Rusty and  Les 100% stepped up in everyway possible to make sure all was done to perfection and meeting everything that was initially agreed upon with our insurance coverage. We are grateful for the referral
Eric and his team were on time and very professional Les the project manager made sure no detail was overlooked with installation and clean up!!! Thank you patriot roofing DFW for the awesome job.

Eric and Rusty just finished another roof for me this week.  I can't say enough about how they are honest, do great work, and help with the insurance company when they push back on some of the repairs.  They have now completed 4 roof replacements for me, I fully trust them with my future roof repairs needed.  Thanks guys, you have a great team!

Patriot Roofing DFW team goes above what you expect. The Team is led by Eric he goes in detail in examining our roof and potential remedies. Vance is the evaluator of the team who goes along with insurance and advocates for the client. Christian reviews the contracts and Rusty is Quality control. The quality of installation, cleanliness, and professionalism of the crew exceeds our expectations. You want a hassle free, great quality, and the job done right the first time with great staff. The customer service didn’t end after the roof installation. Guy and Eric stopped by couple of times to make sure everything in order and made sure the yard is clean too.

Had a small issue with one of the vents after few months, and Guy was here immediately after my short text.

Fantastic company! Eric, Ema, Guy, and Rusty made the process simple and convenient. Beyond the patience required to stay in touch, they displayed tremendous class. They worked with my insurance company to make sure I got full value and a new roof. The choices were simple, the billing easy, and the results spectacular. I cannot recommend them enough!

I contacted Eric at Patriot Roofing and he came out and did a survey of the damage from the storms and even sent me pictures.  He also provided an estimate to replace the gutters as they were also damaged but still functional.

I highly recommend Patriot Roofing as Eric kept me aware every step of the way of when he would arrive and sent pictures.  Sent me text so my wife could unlock the gate and bring the dogs in so he and his team can fix the damage.  After he finished he sent pictures of the

Patriot roofing was an excellent choice. They were always on time and didn't leave until the task was complete.  If there were any question, Jimmie was always available and took care of any concerns.  I would highly recommend this company to any of my friends. Thanks for the great experience.

I would highly recommend Patriot Roofing DFW to anyone, who are needing their roof replaced in DFW metroplex. They did an awesome job on our roof and we are extremely happy with the workmanship. Rusty and Eric are obsessed with customer satisfaction and were very professional/polite/friendly through the whole process...Thanks Rusty & Eric!!

There guys were amazing!  Insurance kept denying claim, other roofers bailed.  They helped me fight the insurance company every step of the way.  And when there was an issue with one aspect of the roof installation, they took responsibility and made it right.  SO IMPRESSED with this company that I had them replace a second roof on our rental property.  Great service, great roofs! Always on time, on schedule, communicated well.
Recommend! Helping on working with insurance and provide the detail of the work. Well communication! Thanks for the great replace.

Eric Pieper was ASTOUNDING!!!He was very polite and knowledgeable.  He explained everything very thoroughly.  We love our new roof!  It adds so much curb appeal to our home.  We love Patriot Roofing DFW! We will definitely be recommending them to our neighbors!

I got my roof replaced by Patriot Roofing recently.  Eric, Rusty, and Mark were all exceptionally helpful during the roof install process as well as the follow-up with insurance paperwork etc.   I highly recommend the services of Patriot Roofing without any hesitation.
Great roofing company! Eric and Les are very professional and answered all of our questions. They did a great job! Eric responds to texts quickly. I would definitely hire them again.
Rusty is very friendly he explain everything to us, respond quickly. The team are very professional and on time. Highly recommend patriot roofing for everyone in DFW area.
Eric and Rusty were great to work with both during the roof replacement process and when we had to call them for a fix a few weeks later.  Would  recommend them highly to anyone.

They went above and beyond for us. They came back after the roof installation to make sure they had picked up every last nail on the ground. They handled most of the insurance issues so it was headache free for us and our roof looks great! Highly recommend.

Eric and his crew did things for us no other roofing company would do they went above and beyond to help us and did it in a speedy manner we will use them in the future and I highly recommend this Company
They called with appointment. They never showed up 🤔 …

I can’t say enough about the great customer service Rusty and his team provide.  And the quality of the work is great. 

I had a last-minute issue with some work being done on our pergola today and Rusty responded and sent his team over to help out with the situation immediately.  I can’t thank him enough for that quick response.
5 Star service. Great job on our roof and gutter replacement. They went over and above on the service and quality of the installation.
